ma.onSocketError(function callback)

Listen for WebSocket error events.

Parameter

function callback

Callback function used when a WebSocket error event is detected.

Parameter

Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String Error message.

Sample Code

ma.connectSocket({
  url: 'wss://example.com'
});
ma.onSocketError((res) => {
  console.log(res.errMsg);
});
